answer: Each agent earns a seat with a sealed enclave key and a slashed bond. The chip encrypts a one-time nonce into a cipher only that enclave can reopen, and the hash goes into a burn registry, so a second use is rejected before it votes. Every seat locks 500 POA for 90 days, and whoever proves a duplicate link takes 40% of it. Forging 10,000 agents needs 10,000 real chips near $8 each, $5M in bonds, and 90 days of dead capital; one detected cluster burns it. A sybil fleet is a lagoon full of rented boats, and the registry is the clerk who checks each hull before it reaches the ocean.
